Key Features

Built For Performance & Discovery

Enhanced with ultra-fast song playback, built-in AI music recommendation, synchronized lyrics, and parametric EQ tuning.

Low Latency & Swift Playback

Optimized InnerTube stream handling for lightning-fast song startup, zero buffering delay, and ultra-swift track switching.

Open-Source AI Recommendation Engine

Integrated smart recommendation engine for personalized song discovery and dynamic queue generation based on your listening habits.

Live Synced Lyrics & AI Translation

Sing along with Apple-style synchronized lyrics. Translate foreign lyrics in real-time with pronunciation transliteration (Hindi, Furigana, Pinyin, Hangul).

10-Band Parametric Equalizer

Fine-tune your sound with a 10-band parametric EQ, headphone calibration profiles (4,000+ presets), loudness normalization, and crossfade.

Material 3 Themes & Pure OLED Black

Tailor your app with Light, Dark, Pure Pitch Black, wallpaper accent colors, and 19 custom color schemes.

Listen Together Rooms

Host virtual rooms with friends. Synchronize playback, track switching, and queue changes live in real time.
